content_blocks.heading_text: Project Management Careers in Port City Savannah

Savannah's role as a major East Coast logistics hub and advanced manufacturing center creates steady demand for certified project managers. The Georgia Ports Authority, which operates critical container and rail terminals serving regional and national commerce, regularly seeks PMs to oversee terminal expansions and operational improvements. Gulfstream Aerospace, headquartered at Savannah/Hilton Head International Airport, manages complex aerospace manufacturing and facility projects that require disciplined project oversight. content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Savannah

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your educational background and years of hands-on project work. Granite PM Academy's team can help you verify eligibility before you enroll in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Attend Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our Savannah-based instructors deliver all required contact hours in a structured format that fits working professionals' schedules. You'll study the PMBOK® Guide and exam domains in real time with peers and expert guidance.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your PMP application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process. PMI will review your credentials and approve your exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy offers targeted exam-preparation resources and practice assessments to build your confidence. You'll take the computer-based PMP exam at an authorized testing center. Our instructors remain available to answer questions before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you'll maintain the credential by earning professional development units (PDUs) within PMI's three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning opportunities and PDU-eligible courses to keep your certification current and your skills sharp.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
